title: A Package Delivered by Mistake
setting: A neighbor's package was delivered to your door, so you bring it over.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hey, sorry to bother you, but I think this package was delivered to me by mistake.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思打扰你，我想这个包裹可能是误送到我这里了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Oh, really? Let me check the name on it.
dialogue.zh: 哦，是吗？我看看上面的名字。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Yeah, it looks like it's yours. I figured I'd bring it over before I forgot.
dialogue.zh: 对，看起来是你的。我想着趁没忘记，直接给你送过来。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thanks, I appreciate it. I've been waiting for this all week.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，真的很感谢。我等这个包裹已经等了一整个星期了。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: No worries. I almost opened it before I noticed the address.
dialogue.zh: 没事。我差点就打开了，后来才注意到上面的地址。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good catch. Our apartment numbers are pretty easy to mix up.
dialogue.zh: 幸亏你发现了。我们的公寓门牌号确实挺容易弄混的。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Definitely. Anyway, glad it made it to the right place.
dialogue.zh: 确实。总之，它最后送到正确的地方就好。

expressions.zh: 不好意思打扰一下，不过……
expressions.note: A polite, natural opener before asking or explaining something.
Especially natural when something went to the wrong person or place.
A relaxed American-English way to explain a small decision.

expressions.zh: 幸亏你发现了 / 你注意到了。
expressions.note: Common when someone notices an easy-to-miss problem.
You can say mix A up with B when two things are confused.

exercise: Your coworker left a phone in the meeting room and you bring it back. Reply in 2–3 natural English sentences. Try to use at least two of: No worries / I figured I'd… / Good catch / before I forgot.
